      "rationale": "Resolves CI reliability issues on the 32.x branch by preventing concurrent container jobs from colliding over Docker subnets."

    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to man pages and release notes templates are mechanical artifacts accompanying the backports.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,

      "rationale": "Does not primarily change documentation; man page and template changes merely follow the backported code."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor fee estimator edits in `src/policy/fees/estimator_man.cpp` are secondary backport diffs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not meaningfully alter mempool data structures, limits, or transaction acceptance policies."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No substantive changes to block template construction or mining RPCs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch the mining subsystem."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/private_broadcast.cpp`, `src/private_broadcast.h`, and `src/net_processing.cpp` to fix private broadcast connection completion and retry tracking.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes private broadcast connection setup to ensure all three initial connections are made and prevents stale retries, protecting transaction origin privacy and relay reliability."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Fixes `bitcoin-cli` socket timeout handling when `-rpcclienttimeout=0` is supplied.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a macOS and BSD failure where `bitcoin-cli` with `-rpcclienttimeout=0` errors out because `select()` rejects timeouts above 10^8 seconds with EINVAL."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Fuzz and functional test updates specifically target private broadcast behavior rather than general test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications are area-specific tests for private broadcast rather than framework or test-runner machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",

      "rationale": "Does not substantively modify developer or operator tooling."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Capping timeout in `Sock::Wait` is directly tied to the `bitcoin-cli` RPC client fix.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Changes to socket utilities directly serve the RPC client fix rather than standalone utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
